channel.title: Wyatt's Notes — DSE
channel.description: Hong Kong DSE revision notes for Mathematics, Physics, Chemistry, and Biology.

item.title: Forces and Motion
item.description: Newton's laws of motion, F=ma calculations, free body diagrams, and applications of Newton's laws. An object remains at rest or continues to move with uniform velocity unless acted upon by a resultant force.

item.title: Mechanics — In-Depth Coverage
item.description: Advanced mechanics topics including projectile motion, circular motion, momentum, and impulse with detailed derivations and exam-style problems.

item.title: Energy and Work
item.description: Work-energy theorem, conservation of energy, potential and kinetic energy calculations, and power. Worked examples for DSE physics examination.

item.title: Waves and Sound
item.description: Properties of waves, reflection, refraction, diffraction, and sound waves. Transverse and longitudinal wave characteristics with DSE examination focus.

item.title: Waves and Optics
item.description: Electromagnetic spectrum, light waves, mirrors, lenses, and optical instruments. Comprehensive coverage for DSE physics Paper 1 and Paper 2.

item.title: Optics
item.description: Reflection at plane mirrors, refraction through glass blocks, total internal reflection, and lens formula applications.

item.title: Electrical Circuits
item.description: Ohm's law, series and parallel circuits, Kirchhoff's laws, and circuit analysis techniques for DSE physics.

item.title: Electricity and Magnetism
item.description: Electric fields, magnetic fields, and the relationship between electricity and magnetism. Electromagnetic induction and applications.

item.title: Magnetism and Electromagnetism
item.description: Properties of magnets, magnetic fields around conductors, solenoids, and electromagnetic devices. DSE examination preparation.

item.title: Heat and Gases
item.description: Thermal energy transfer, ideal gas law, kinetic theory of gases, and specific heat capacity calculations for DSE physics.

item.title: Nuclear Physics
item.description: Atomic structure, radioactive decay, half-life calculations, nuclear fission and fusion, and radiation safety. Complete DSE nuclear physics coverage.

item.title: DSE Physics — Complete Course
item.description: 161 pages of DSE Physics notes covering mechanics, waves, electricity, magnetism, thermal physics, and nuclear physics with diagnostic tests.

item.title: Diagnostic Guide — Physics Topics
item.description: Interactive diagnostic tests to identify strengths and weaknesses across all DSE Physics topics. Personalised study recommendations.

item.title: Hong Kong DSE Notes — All Subjects
item.description: 161 pages of Hong Kong DSE revision notes for Mathematics, Physics, Chemistry, and Biology with diagnostic tests and practice questions.
